title: AwesomeToDos
description: Create good looking and structured ToDo-Lists and various categories.
body:
![Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb039d33089f4ca9819e48854312599a389ed3d9_0.webp)
![description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98c18a088183c0c5fd9080f8da2df97a9d492104_0.webp)
AwesomeToDo’s is a ToDo-List plugin for Minecraft servers (Paper, Tuinity, Purpur). You can easily create your own categories with many ToDo’s which have to get done.
If you have many projects going on this plugin is helping you out to get some structure to your plannings.
Thanks to the GUI based design its incredibly easy to use and configure.
AwesomeToDo’s is highly customizable – you can change any itemtype or message.

Use **/todo help** to get started.

Support is provided on [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/4pr7X35sNC).
If you want the german translation just hit me up.

![features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cfaff1121b35e8cc80d975035e98acf0f15d6b98_0.webp)
- Different categories
- ToDo’s for each category in an own GUI
- Different priorities (High, Medium, Low)
- Different status (In Planning, Open, Work in Progress, In Verification, Finished)
- Deadline
- Announcement when a deadline exceeded
- Description for ToDo’s
- Possibility to add Members to each ToDo
- Teleport feature for ToDo’s
- Sorting algorithms for ToDo's
- Ingame + Config configuration
- Unique itemtypes for categories and ToDo’s
- CustomModelData support
- Completely translatable
- Tab completion
- Placeholders
